stem: What happens next in this passage after “The student had always imagined history as large events.”?
options: It showed tests, club days, birthdays, and school events.
The diary showed history from inside one person's day.
The next day, she wrote her name inside her shoes.
The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily choices are part of the large picture.
